latest_content:
: ''Not to be confused with the similar'' Beast Wars ''mission [[Proving Fields|Proving '''Fields''']]''
'''Proving Grounds''' is a set of [[Special Mission]]s in the [[Transformers: Forged to Fight (Netflix)|Netflix release]] of the game. This helps Commanders familiarize - or reacquaint - themselves with the Beast Bots. [[wp:Transformers: Rise of the Beasts|This is definitely appropiate considering this film's concurrent release!]]

== Missions ==
Each mission will consume '''3''' [[File:Energy.png|15px|link=Energy]]. For each, all 5-Star Bots have been ranked up 50/50 with their Sigs at level 100.

Completion of each mission will yield 300 [[Bot Chip]]s.

=== Set One: [[Cheetor]] ===
'''Enemies:'''
* [[Optimus Primal]]
* [[Rhinox]]
* [[Dinobot]]
